products.name: Alvin
products.Description: Brave and reliable: Alvin is known for his courageous nature, making him a dependable partner whether you’re looking to compete or just enjoy at home. Forgiving Nature: His forgiving disposition means he’s perfect for riders looking to gain confidence or hone their skills. Versatile: At 16.2 hands, Alvin accommodates riders of all sizes, making him an excellent fit for anyone from ambitious amateurs to young competitors. Not Just a Competitor: Alvin is also incredibly eye-catching, with his striking white face and adorable markings that make him stand out in the ring. He’s not just a great horse; he’s a stunning one too! Current Location: San Diego, CA. Alvin comes with an impeccable vetting history and recent x-rays, ensuring you can ride with peace of mind. He requires no prep and no maintenance, making him a hassle-free addition to your stable. At just 8 years old, he has many exciting years ahead! Don’t miss out on the chance to partner with this incredible horse! Contact us today for more information or to schedule a visit. Alvin is ready to help you achieve your riding goals!

products.name: Contest Z
products.Description: Brave, fun and flashy 1m20 jumper with lots of miles and a big heart! Imported as a 6 year old from France, Z took on to the American riding and proved himself to be quite a partner! Loves to jump and is always game. 16’2, 10 years old, perfect for a kid doing the 1m+ and wanting to go up the levels to the 1m20s. Show record up to 1m30s in USA. Very fun bubbly personality, light and fast on his feet, truly a fun partner for a competitive teenager wanting a bold partner in crime. Located in Temecula.

products.name: Hooverphonic
products.Description: Hoover, proven 1m50+ Grand Prix champion. Tons of miles, has even competed in the 1m60 Million Dollar GP. A horse that only knows one thing: Jump to the other side, nothing is too much for him. Truly a competitor for an ambitious rider to conquer their first big rings and get a taste for the real deal. Still competing in the GPs, with some recent wins! Would consider a short term and long term lease to the right program, terms to be discussed. USEF 5356441

products.name: Corado
products.Description: Looking for the perfect companion to conquer the county shows? Meet Corado! This cute horse is ready to shine in all three rings, effortlessly tackling the 3′ and under divisions. Equally adept in all three rings, Corado will shine in all 3 rings. Impeccable lead changes, huge stride. Beyond his cuteness, Corado boasts a fun and amiable personality. Having showcased his talent as a younger horse in the hunter rings, Corado then proved himself as a great horse to enjoy at home and is now ready to go back into the ring! Dark bay with Chrome,… what else! Comes with recent X-rays, including comprehensive views of the neck and back, and no need for maintenance. Located in Temecula. Don’t miss the opportunity to make Corado your own! Contact us now to schedule a viewing and trial to get a feel for him first hand!

products.name: Georg
products.Description: Look out because we have an international champion available in our sales barn that is simply the sweetest soul to bring a young rider up the levels! And when we say up we mean from the .80s to the 1m30s easily! 13 year old with a show record in the 1.50s ready to teach the ropes for all level riders! Unstoppable, no holes, dude personality that just enjoys everything and anyone he gets to spend time on! 16’3, big build, available for trials at Seaside horse show until the end of the circuit! Located by Temecula!

products.name: Padden
products.Description: 14 year old with the biggest heart there is, reliable at any height and for any level rider. Show miles up to 1m60, wins in the 1m40+, brave and scopy as can be without being Technical. Forgiving, perfect for the riders that don’t always get it right but want to start playing in the bigger rings! On top of being ALL of that…. he can also play in the equitation ring and will jump water for someone to venture into the USET! Owner’s loss is your gain, it will be an honor for whomever gets him to start competing right away with this SOLID citizen that just wants to work hard and please his rider. 17’1 , USEF 5369384, Located in Orange county and will be at Thermal for the rest of the circuit this year. Many videos available on demand.

products.name: Fiona
products.Description: This extraordinary mare is available for purchase. SHe is the absolute show horse with more wins we can count in the 1.30-1.35s. Big big heart, scope, polite speed, the perfect horse to bring a teenager into the big rings in all safety. Learn how to ride proper and get a feel for the real deal. At 12 years old FIona has proven over and over she is the ultimate show horse. Zero mare drama, she is all business and will always follow through with her duty. 16 '1, modern and uphill, she is what everyone is looking for right now.  Located in Orange County.

products.name: Cabavara
products.Description: Catty, brave, fast, refined, with tons of blood and adjustability, careful as can be. For someone looking for a real horse to turn into a Markel GP horse, this 7 year old is the one. She has proven to have tons of scope leaving feet of air between her and the fence, has all the ability to turn and burn, yes has the best snaffle mouth one would want. 16 '2, Spectacular bloodlines (Cabachon and Balou du Rouet) she is a machine in the making! successfully did the 6 years old in Europe prior to being imported, ready to get going in the competitive 1m30s. Located in Temecula.

products.name: Contact
products.Description: Ex GP horse to teach you how things are done in the GP ring. 17'2 power house, kindest soul, Contact has proven himself over and over again and is the perfect horse for a bold amateur or teenager looking to get going in the 1m15s. Auto lead changes, push ride on the flat but total champ once you start jumping. at 15, he requires limited maintenance and still has some solid years in him! Located in Temecula. USEF 5283871

products.name: Perfect Boy Du Faurieu Z
products.Description: GP gelding in the making. At only 9 years old P-boy is winning the 1m40s with a young rider in California. Will end up being the perfect Markel horse for an ambitious rider looking to make it to the top. Lots of show miles in Europe up to 1m45s, placing thoroughly in speed classes and young rider divisions here in CA. Sensitive ride with lots of quality, not a kick and pull horse, needs a rider that rides with finesse and knows how to appreciate quality upper level horses. 16’2, 9 years old. Located in Temecula.

products.name: Spiderman k
products.Description: 17h, 8yr Imported Oldenburger Warmblood gelding by Special Effect x Caretino 2. “Marvel” has a record in the jumpers up to 1.30m in the states, but is most happy in the equitation and hunter divisions. He competed last year on the gold circuit in the CET medal, Jump Canada, 3’6ft Junior hunters, and the 3’6ft Derby’s with great results. This summer he’s done the trillium circuit with his current leaser in the adult 3’ and the trillium 3’3ft. He is as brave as they come and has the sweetest personality. Marvel is not for a beginner and is more of an experienced junior/ amateur or pro ride, he is still young. He has a beautiful jump in every ring and plenty of scope. He clips, bathes, and stands. His lead change is almost auto.

products.name: Fanette Frivole
products.Description: 2015 16.0 hand Selle Francais Mare, Competed in France up to 1.25m in the 6 years old category. Imported in 2022 from France to Canada. Currently competing 1.15 with an amateur. Potential to jump up to 1.30 with a good amateur. Currently showing 3'9 or 1.15m 3+ Years Showing. Brave, forgiving, big heart, like to compete, she has blood. Very polyvalent: trail rides, eventing, equitation. Full vet check available. Travels well.
